heading: More Edstellar coaching for every leadership stage.
description: Team coaching is one of six Edstellar coaching paths. The five individual paths run on Meridian.

items.title: Executive coaching
items.description: A confidential thinking partner for leaders who set direction, carry the strategy and lead other leaders.

items.title: Leadership coaching
items.description: For directors, senior managers and high-potential talent getting ready for bigger roles and wider scope.

items.title: First-time manager coaching
items.description: Support through the first step from strong individual contributor to manager of people.

items.title: Career and transition coaching
items.description: Coaching through promotions, role changes, restructures and returns to work, so leaders find their direction and land well in what comes next.

items.title: Performance coaching
items.description: Focused coaching on one personal capability to build, from confidence and focus to staying clear under pressure.
